profile.name: Win Min Htet
profile.headline: Software Developer | Mobile App Developer
profile.shortBio: Senior Mobile Developer specializing in Flutter, maintaining and developing Mahar Movie, Mahar Music, Mahar Android TV, and Mahar CH. Also building practical apps for real users, including NgweWin for money tracking and MMSubber, an all-in-one subtitle editor for Myanmar translators.
profile.longBio: Senior Mobile Developer specializing in Flutter application development, currently maintaining and building features for Mahar Movie, while also contributing to Mahar Music, Mahar Android TV, and Mahar CH. Experienced in developing scalable mobile applications, integrating APIs, and working with Firebase and cloud services. Beyond professional work, I build practical, user-focused applications, including NgweWin, a money transfer and withdrawal tracking app, and MMSubber, an all-in-one subtitle editor designed to empower local Myanmar translators.
